mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.10% in a monthly reading, it signals imminent aggressive monetary easing that precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.10%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts (HOUST) exceed 580,000 units in a monthly reading, it signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 580.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in CPIAUCSL by more than 0.2% signals potential Fed policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL declines by >0.2% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines by >0.2% during high inflation periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in new housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer and business confidence, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and RSAFS increases in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
